pay_detail: Tuition $900 plus a $100 registration fee credited to tuition. Optional housing with meals was $500 in 2026; the 2027 rate is not set. Need-based aid exists.
name: Summer Saxophone Academy (Jacobs School of Music)
org: Jacobs Academy, Jacobs School of Music, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A one-week saxophone program. You get four one-on-one lessons (classical or jazz), a technique class, master classes and group playing.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 18. You send a placement recording so you can be placed in studios and groups.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 registration opens mid-December 2026. Registration, payment and placement recording are due May 15, 2027. Financial aid is due April 13, 2027.
how_to_apply: Finish the online sign-up and pay the $100 fee and tuition. Then upload a recording for placement in the Jacobs audition portal.
